game.title: Kingdom Hearts III

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Steam app 2552450 is "KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)"; its schema calls the app "Tres" (an internal codename). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0. Of its many linked subpages, 13 exist: "Olympus" (about 25,000 characters) and "Twilight Town" (about 6,000) are written, as are "Walkthrough" (about 5,100) and "Achievements and trophies" (about 7,600); "Toy Box", "Monstropolis", "Arendelle" and "Hundred Acre Wood" are near-empty (under 600 characters each); the other world pages, such as "Kingdom of Corona", "The Caribbean", "San Fransokyo" and "Keyblade Graveyard", are linked but not created. Too little is written to use, so nothing was taken. kingdomhearts.fandom.com answers the API, with about 219 linked pages, including "Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 6 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden. The world chapters group the nine world achievements in their Steam order, which matches falling unlock rates (69% down to 31%); the real play order may differ. "Beyond the Curtain" (hidden, 5%) was placed in Re Mind by its name, next to "Behind the Curtain"; "Flanmeister" and "Thermosphere" are hidden too and sit in The Finale as placeholders, though they are probably side goals. RAWG has no playtime figure for this game.
